title: Bronze Layer Metadata File
description: Schema for metadata.json written alongside each ingested CSV in the bronze ADLS container at source=pvdaq/dataset={dataset}/ingestion_date={date}/metadata.json. Fields that require CSV column parsing are null at bronze and populated by the silver layer.

dataset.description: Dataset identity — the primary key across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.

dataset_id.description: Logical dataset identifier: {site_id}_{category} (e.g. '9068_ac_power'). Stable across versions.

version.description: Ingestion version. Starts at 1 and increments on each re-ingestion triggered by a changed S3 LastModified.

schema_version.description: Schema version is 'unknown' at bronze — no schema is applied to the raw CSV.

tags.description: Classification tags for discovery and filtering. Example: ['pvdaq', 'solar'].

source.description: Origin of the dataset — WHERE it came from. Enables per-provider debugging and outage correlation.

source_type.description: How data is accessed. 's3_public' = unauthenticated public S3 bucket (OEDI).

endpoint.description: S3 prefix of the source file (e.g. 'pvdaq/2023-solar-data-prize/9068_OEDI/data/').

provider.description: Organisation that publishes the data. OEDI is operated by NREL.

region.description: AWS region hosting the oedi-data-lake S3 bucket.

ingestion.description: HOW the file arrived — enables deduplication, idempotency, rerun tracking, and latency anomaly detection.

ingestion_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the file finished writing to ADLS.

ingestion_id.description: UUID identifying this specific ingestion run. Shared with the CloudEvent correlation_id.

batch_id.description: Correlation ID of the dispatcher run that enqueued this file. Groups all files ingested together.

pipeline.description: Name and version of the ingestion pipeline that wrote this file.

trigger_type.description: 'scheduled' for normal timer-triggered runs; 'rerun' when re-ingesting a file whose S3 LastModified changed (version > 1).

retry_count.description: Number of S3 HTTP retries performed before success. 0 = first attempt succeeded.

source_file_name.description: Original S3 basename of the downloaded file (e.g. '9068_ac_power_data.csv').

file_size_bytes.description: File size in bytes as reported by the S3 listing.

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file content computed incrementally during streaming upload (64 lowercase hex chars).

ingestion_latency_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from stream download start to ADLS flush completion.

status.description: Always 'success' — metadata.json is only written on successful ingestion.

event_time.description: WHAT time window the data represents. Critical for gap detection. Range fields are null at bronze (require CSV column parsing) and populated by the silver layer.

event_time_start.description: Earliest event timestamp in the dataset. null at bronze — populated by silver layer with timestamp column knowledge.

event_time_end.description: Latest event timestamp in the dataset. null at bronze — populated by silver layer with timestamp column knowledge.

expected_frequency_seconds.description: Expected measurement interval in seconds. For PVDAQ: 300 (5-minute intervals). Used by silver layer for gap detection.

expected_records.description: Expected number of rows given event_time range and frequency. null at bronze since event_time_start/end are unknown.

data_profile.description: Lightweight data signals computed during ingestion. Fields requiring column-level parsing are null at bronze and computed by silver. row_count is the only field populated at bronze (newline count during streaming).

row_count.description: Count of newline characters encountered during streaming upload. Approximates CSV rows (includes header) without column parsing. The only data_profile field populated at bronze.

null_percentage.description: Fraction of cells that are null across all columns. null at bronze — computed by silver layer.

duplicate_rows.description: Number of exact duplicate rows. null at bronze — computed by silver layer.

min_timestamp.description: Minimum value in the primary timestamp column. null at bronze — computed by silver layer.

max_timestamp.description: Maximum value in the primary timestamp column. null at bronze — computed by silver layer.

schema_detected.description: Whether a schema was inferred from the file. Always null at bronze (no schema inference). Populated by silver.

corrupted_rows.description: Number of rows that failed parsing. null at bronze — computed by silver layer. Bronze preserves ALL rows including corrupted ones.

quality_hint.description: Lightweight quality pre-checks. Bronze does NOT fully validate, but captures early signals that silver and ML layers consume. All fields are null at bronze.

basic_quality_score.description: Composite quality score 0.0–1.0. null at bronze — computed by silver layer after profiling.

schema_valid.description: Whether the file passes schema validation. null at bronze — no schema is applied. Populated by silver.

time_continuity_suspected_gap.description: Whether a temporal gap is suspected in the event_time range. null at bronze (event_time_start/end unknown). Populated by silver.

notes.description: Human-readable notes from the ingestion pipeline. Empty at bronze unless the pipeline detects an anomaly (e.g. file size unexpectedly small).

lineage.description: Audit trail and ML feedback linkage. Enables rerun tracking, incident correlation, and training data lineage.

parent_dataset_version.description: Version number of the previous ingestion of this dataset. null if this is the first ingestion (version == 1).

rerun_of.description: Identifier of the dataset version this is a rerun of (e.g. '9068_ac_power_v1'). null if trigger_type is 'scheduled'.

related_incident_id.description: Incident or ticket ID that triggered a manual rerun. null for scheduled ingestions.
